paragraphs.text: Larine Arneza is a first-year human student of Quandrix College at Strixhaven University. Known for her artistic flair and love of aquatic performance, she divides her time between dance, animals, and her work in the university's theater scene.

Larine has a reputation for aloofness, though her friends insist she's simply absentminded, not unfriendly. Those who know her well find her kind, whimsical, and delightfully eccentric. She often becomes so absorbed in her thoughts that social interactions are forgotten entirely.

Larine is an active member of the Intramural Water-Dancing Club, where she excels at fluid, underwater ballet. Her performances are graceful, but she struggles with group choreography due to her tendency to drift off mentally mid-rehearsal. Ever creative, Larine is developing a unique solo routine choreographed alongside a shoal of fish, though the fish have not been cooperating as planned.

She works for the Strixhaven Performing Arts Society as a ticket taker, having recently transferred from box office duties after persistent challenges with handling change correctly. Despite the setback, she remains cheerful and dedicated to supporting student performances.
Larine also possesses a natural affinity for animals, particularly aquatic creatures, which often factor into both her performances and personal projects.

Friends who need to escape unwanted attention or slip away unnoticed can often count on Larine or her fellow performers to stage a timely diversion, while her rivals are offered the worst tickets to performances, if any at all.
